template.name: ProcedureActivityObservationV2
template.desc: The common notion of procedure is broader than that specified by the HL7 Version 3 Reference Information Model (RIM). Therefore procedure templates can be represented with various RIM classes: act (e.g., dressing change), observation (e.g., EEG), procedure (e.g., splenectomy). This template represents procedures that result in new information about the patient that cannot be classified as a procedure according to the HL7 RIM. Examples of these procedures are diagnostic imaging procedures, EEGs, and EKGs.

attribute.name: classCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @classCode="OBS" Observation (CodeSystem: HL7ActClass urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.6 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8282).

attribute.name: moodCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @moodCode="EVN" Event (CodeSystem: ActMood urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1001 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8237).

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: C-CDA R1.1 templateId root without an extension

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] templateId (CONF:1098-8238) such that it

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: SHALL contain at least one [1..*] id (CONF:1098-8239).

element.name: cda:code
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] code (CONF:1098-19197).

element.name: cda:originalText
element.desc: This code SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] originalText (CONF:1098-19198).

element.name: cda:reference
element.desc: The originalText, if present, SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] reference (CONF:1098-19199).

attribute.name: value
attribute.desc: The reference, if present, SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] @value (CONF:1098-19200).

element.assert: This reference/@value *SHALL* begin with a '#' and *SHALL* point to its corresponding narrative (using the approach defined in CDA Release 2, section 4.3.5.1).

element.name: cda:statusCode
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] statusCode (CONF:1098-8245).

element.name: cda:effectiveTime
element.desc: SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] effectiveTime (CONF:1098-8246).

element.name: cda:priorityCode
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] priorityCode, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Act Priority urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.1.11.16866 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-8247).

element.name: cda:value
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] value (CONF:1098-16846).

attribute.name: nullFlavor
attribute.desc: This value MAY contain zero or one [0..1] @nullFlavor (CONF:1098-32778).

element.name: cda:methodCode
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] methodCode (CONF:1098-8248).
element.constraint: methodCode *SHALL NOT* conflict with the method inherent in Observation / code.

element.name: cda:targetSiteCode
element.desc: SHOULD contain zero or more [0..*] targetSiteCode, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Body Site urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.3221.8.9 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-8250).

element.name: cda:performer
element.desc: SHOULD contain zero or more [0..*] performer (CONF:1098-8251).

element.name: cda:assignedEntity
element.desc: The performer, if present, SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] assignedEntity (CONF:1098-8252).

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: This assignedEntity SHALL contain at least one [1..*] id (CONF:1098-8253).

element.name: cda:addr
element.desc: This assignedEntity SHALL contain at least one [1..*] addr (CONF:1098-8254).

element.name: cda:telecom
element.desc: This assignedEntity SHALL contain at least one [1..*] telecom (CONF:1098-8255).

element.name: cda:representedOrganization
element.desc: This assignedEntity SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] representedOrganization (CONF:1098-8256).

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, SHOULD contain zero or more [0..*] id (CONF:1098-8257).

element.name: cda:name
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, MAY contain zero or more [0..*] name (CONF:1098-8258).

element.name: cda:telecom
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] telecom (CONF:1098-8260).

element.name: cda:addr
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] addr (CONF:1098-8259).

element.name: cda:author
element.desc: SHOULD contain [0..*] Author Participation (identifier: urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.10.20.22.4.119) (CONF:1098-32478).

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="LOC" Location (CodeSystem: HL7ParticipationType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.90 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8262).

element.name: cda:entryRelationship
element.desc: MAY contain zero or more [0..*] entryRelationship (CONF:1098-8264) such that it

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="COMP" Component (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8265).

element.name: cda:encounter
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] encounter (CONF:1098-8267).

attribute.name: classCode
attribute.desc: This encounter SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @classCode="ENC" Encounter (CodeSystem: HL7ActClass urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.6 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8268).

attribute.name: moodCode
attribute.desc: This encounter SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @moodCode="EVN" Event (CodeSystem: ActMood urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1001 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8269).

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: This encounter SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] id (CONF:1098-8270).
element.constraint: Set encounter/id to the id of an encounter in another section to signify they are the same encounter.

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="SUBJ" Has Subject (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8273).

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="RSON" Has Reason (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8277).

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="COMP" Has Component (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8280).

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="COMP" Has Component (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002) (CONF:1098-32471).
